warning_texts: Part of the completion-rate gap between channels is orders still pending, not orders cancelled: pending is about 14 percent of direct and 20 percent of partner orders in the quarter, and a pending order may still be delivered, so the gap describes status at export time rather than final completion.
Both test p-values are stored as 0.0000000000 with display_digits 4, so they would render as 0.0000; the release should say p < 0.0001 instead of a literal zero.

Bonferroni over the two registered tests means a per-test alpha of 0.025; the claims record alpha 0.05 and the correction name but not the adjusted alpha. The conclusion is unaffected (z about 26.7, t about 42.7), but the adjusted threshold is written nowhere.
